newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS upgrades Laidlaw senior debt.
newsitem.headline: CBRS upgrades Laidlaw senior debt.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday it upgraded the senior debt rating of Laidlaw Inc and assigned a stable rating outlook.

CBRS said it upgraded the rating of Laidlaw's Senior Unsecured Debentures to B++ from B++(Low). Laidlaw's ADT-linked Convertible Debentures and Cumulative Convertible Preferred Shares have been reaffirmed at B+(High) and P-3(Low) respectively, the rating agency said.
The rating upgrade reflects Laidlaw's improving performance and growing diversification from its transportation and waste management businesses, CBRS said.
The company has also shown its intention to maintain a prudent level of debt thorugh the use of common equity to fund a portion of its purchase of Scott's Hospitality Inc, CBRS said.
Laidlaw has also been improving its financial performance in terms of earnings and cash flow and reducing its overall debt leverage, CBRs said.
